4. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner no. 8, Arjuman Begum shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, subject to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also to comply with the conditions as laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

The petitioner no. 8 shall meet the Investigating Officer once in a week or as and when called for till the submission of the final report and on further condition that the petitioner no. 8 shall appear before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chanchal, Malda corresponding to G.R Case No.
4084 of 2023 within two weeks from date.
